KISWAHILI — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. zito
   B. pana
   C. nene
   D. fupi

2. When practising Ushairi 1.2.1 Uainishaji wa Mashairi ya Arudhi ● Mishororo ● Vipande, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Ushairi 1.2.1 Uainishaji wa Mashairi ya Arudhi ● Mishororo ● Vipande.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Ushairi 1.2.1 Uainishaji wa Mashairi ya Arudhi ● Mishororo ● Vipande.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Ushairi 1.2.1 Uainishaji wa Mashairi ya Arudhi ● Mishororo ● Vipande.

4. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   B. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   C. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   D. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.

5. When practising Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1.1 Ufahamu wa Kusikiliza Ujumbe na fani katika matin, which approach is best? (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Uchambuzi wa Tamthilia and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha kupasha habari and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — fupi

2. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Ushairi 1.2.1 Uainishaji wa Mashairi ya Arudhi ● Mishororo ● Vipande.

3. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Bunilizi na Kazi za Kihalisia 1.3.1 Utangulizi wa Bunilizi na Kazi za Kihalisia.

4. B — Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.

5. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1.1 Ufahamu wa Kusikiliza Ujumbe na fani katika matin.

6. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Utangulizi wa Bunilizi na Kazi za Kihalisia.

7. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Matumizi ya Lugha 1.4.1 Aina za Maneno Aina za: - Nomino - Vivumishi.

8. B — watoto

9. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Fasihi Simulizi 2.1.1 Uchanganuzi wa Hadithi.

10. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Fasihi Simulizi 1.1.1 Misingi ya Fasihi Simulizi Fasihi Simulizi katika Jamii ya.

11. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufasaha Kifungu cha kupasha habari.

12. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Ufahamu wa Kusikiliza Ujumbe na fani katika matini elezi.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Uchambuzi wa Tamthilia; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha kupasha habari; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Fasihi Simulizi 3.1.1 Uchanganuzi wa Semi; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Kuandika 2.3.1 Uandishi wa Kiuamilifu Barua rasmi; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
